description: This file defines the remote cluster service for inter-cluster communication in Mattermost, including interfaces, constants, and methods for managing remote cluster connections, messaging, and listeners.

classes.name: Service
classes.description: Provides inter-cluster communication via topic-based messages, managing listeners, connection states, and pings.

methods.name: NewRemoteClusterService
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the remote cluster service with configured HTTP client and listener maps.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the service, registers leader change listener, and initiates pinging if active.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the service, removes leader change listener, and pauses activity.

methods.name: Active
methods.description: Returns whether the service is currently active.

methods.name: SetPingFreq
methods.description: Sets the ping frequency, used for testing or configuration.

methods.name: AddTopicListener
methods.description: Registers a callback for a specific topic and returns its listener ID.

methods.name: RemoveTopicListener
methods.description: Removes a topic listener by ID.

methods.name: getTopicListeners
methods.description: Retrieves a list of listeners for a specific topic.

methods.name: AddConnectionStateListener
methods.description: Registers a listener for connection state changes.

methods.name: RemoveConnectionStateListener
methods.description: Removes a connection state listener by ID.

methods.name: onClusterLeaderChange
methods.description: Handles changes in cluster leadership status, resuming or pausing the service accordingly.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Activates the service, starts pinging, and message sending routines.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Deactivates the service and stops routines.

methods.name: SetActive
methods.description: Forces the service to be active or inactive, mainly for testing.
